Great — let's start by getting clear on what you really want out of this, before anything gets built.

A quick note on how I'll work with you: we'll go step by step. First I want to understand your goal, then I'll show you working screens to react to — you won't need to organize anything or think in technical terms. I'll handle all of that.

So, starting with the "why":

**When this bookmark app is finished and working well, what would be different from how you handle bookmarks today?** For example — is the pain right now that bookmarks get lost or messy somewhere, that you can't find them again later, that they're scattered across different places, or something else entirely?

And a second thing I'm curious about: when you say "save and manage" — is the heart of this mainly about **collecting** links quickly, or more about **finding them again** later when you need them? Knowing which side matters more will shape everything that follows.

Take it in your own words — there's no wrong answer here.
